description: Check or create a Dockerfile for Code Engine (linux/amd64, port 8080, non-root). Run validate before a build to catch the errors that make a deploy fail. Call get_schema with name dockerfile for every action's fields.

action.description: validate: List errors, warnings, and info for a Dockerfile. Needs dockerfile_path. | scaffold: Generate a Dockerfile for a folder (static, Node.js, or Python). Writes it only when write=true. Needs context_path.

context_path.description: Build context directory (used to check for .dockerignore, etc.)

dockerfile_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the Dockerfile to validate

expected_port.description: Expected container port (default: 8080 for Code Engine)

write.description: Write the Dockerfile to context_path/Dockerfile (default: false — preview only)

name: dockerfile
